item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 04/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Besides, an anticyclone aloft covering southeastern China is expected to strengthen gradually in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be very hot over southern China.

Date/Month: 04/07 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 4, gusty at times.
Weather: Sunny intervals and a few showers. Showers will be heavier with thunderstorms over some areas in the morning. It will be hot.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 05/07 (Wednesday)
Wind: Southwest force 4.
Weather: Hot with sunny intervals and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first.
Temp range: 28 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
